pattern.description: Live screen-recording cursor sweeps up the Delivery table; each row it crosses shows its hover state (row tint, 'Create a delivery ticket' hint), and it settles on the Onboarding row where the title truncates and the open-idea icon appears.
pattern.why_premium: Real hover affordances reveal the delivery-ticket action without narration, priming the 'link ideas to delivery' line that follows.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {x: 0, y: -230, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); per row tl.set('.row-n', {className: '+=is-hover'}, t) then remove; at end tl.set('.row-onboarding .open-icon', {autoAlpha: 1}) and swap title to truncated text.
build_hint.remotion: cursorY = interpolate(frame, [0, 14], [startY, endY], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}); hoveredRow = rows.findIndex(r => cursorY in r); render hover tint, hint and open icon conditionally (no spring).

notes: Filmstrip is a crop of the table's lower-left; hover states are instantaneous UI changes, not authored animation.
